title.en: A patch for an old version

hints.tr: `git checkout v1.0`, sonra `git switch -c <ad>`. Ya da tek komut: `git switch -c <ad> v1.0`.
hints.en: `git checkout v1.0`, then `git switch -c <name>`. Or in one command: `git switch -c <name> v1.0`.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı (komutları sırayla yaz):

```bash
git checkout v1.0
git switch -c hotfix-1.0
echo "fix" > fix.txt
git add .
git commit -m "Fix crash"
```
hints.en:
The full solution (type the commands in order):

```bash
git checkout v1.0
git switch -c hotfix-1.0
echo "fix" > fix.txt
git add .
git commit -m "Fix crash"
```

label.en: hotfix-1.0 sits on v1.0: Fix crash
